prior_attempt.rejection: The first correction separated state borders from arrows, but treated stateArrowColor as unconditionally more specific than ArrowColor. Java normalizes both spellings to the same arrowColor style property, so their declarations override in source order.

invariant: Java resolves state-image borders and state-diagram arrows from sibling style signatures. FromSkinparamToStyle maps stateBorderColor to root.element.stateDiagram.state LineColor, while SkinParam.cleanForKeySlow applies patternCleanArrow to both stateArrowColor and ArrowColor and normalizes them to the same arrowColor key before style conversion. SkinParam.setParam processes declarations in source order, so the later alias overwrites the earlier value on root.element.stateDiagram.arrow. GraphvizImageBuilder and SvekEdge independently merge that arrow signature and derive the shaft and arrowhead Rainbow from it. The arrow signature may inherit the root or theme line color, but never the state sibling's explicit LineColor. A per-link color remains the final arrow-only override.
causal_divergence: Commit ad832e2c correctly stopped falling back from the arrow signature to the resolved state border stroke, but StateSkin::from_diagram still performs two independent reverse lookups and always checks stateArrowColor before ArrowColor. That invents a specificity relation Java does not have. When stateArrowColor appears first and ArrowColor appears later, Java's normalized arrowColor property contains the later global value while Rust keeps the earlier state-prefixed value. The rejected opposite-order heldout isolates this as eight color-only shaft and arrowhead differences.
planned_change: Resolve the diagram arrow color with one reverse source-order lookup whose key predicate accepts either stateArrowColor or ArrowColor, then fall back independently to the root/theme line color and built-in default. Preserve the existing stateBorderColor channel and per-transition final override. Keep both opposite declaration-order controls, border-only control, changed chain lengths, and local link override executable. Do not assign artificial specificity to either alias, special-case a color or fixture, or alter any geometry.
perturbation_axes: stateBorderColor alone with renamed states and changed chain length
stateArrowColor and ArrowColor overriding one another in both source orders
stateBorderColor remaining isolated from both arrow aliases
per-transition color overriding every diagram-level arrow declaration
